documents.title: Exultavit cor nostrum
documents.source_note: English appendix to Turgeon's jubilee pastoral, printed pp.7–10 (PDF pp.8–11). Translator unnamed. CIHM 52209 dates the printing 1852; printing place and publisher unknown ([S.l. : s.n.], tentatively Quebec). Complete printed body includes the opening, 21 November 1851 closing and PIUS IX. Pope subscription. Mechanical re-OCR from primary-page regions excludes duplicated adjacent-page strips; OCR spelling remains uncorrected.
documents.rights_basis: The identified English historical printing was published in 1852, corroborated by the edition-specific CIHM 52209 catalogue and Turgeon's pastoral dated 23 April 1852. Printing place and publisher are unknown: the catalogue gives [S.l. : s.n.] and tentatively suggests Quebec; the wrapper locates the issuer in Quebec. The exact historical text and contemporary printed pages are public domain in the United States by expiration of publication term, under src/sources/inventories/papal-documents-rights-v1.toml. Automated OCR does not add original authorship. Historical source wording is excluded from the project-content licence.
documents.rights_notice: This identified historical English printing is public domain in the United States; source wording retains its own status.

documents.title: Cum Sancta Mater
documents.source_note: Horan dates his pastoral 9 June 1859. The complete English Cum Sancta Mater is printed on pp.1–2, from its address and salutation through the dated 27 April 1859 closing; subsequent Horan commentary and prescriptions are separate. Translator unnamed. Native PDF pages 1–3 inspected, and the entire act OCR read. The source has no separate papal subscription. OCR retains word breaks and misreads the year as 185). Publication year 1859 is corroborated by CIHM 51176 and Horan's dated pastoral. Its catalogue gives [Kingston, Ont? : s.n.]: the printing place is inferred, and the printed imprint and publisher are unknown.
